mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation models, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 10.0% within a 3-month window signals severe labor market contraction, triggering immediate flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% from prior month indicate broad-based demand contraction, signaling imminent economic slowdown and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shocks (INDPRO below 85.0% of 2017 base), manufacturing output disruptions increase inflation expectations and reduce corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 85.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200.0 thousand units within 3 months indicates residential construction collapse, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1200.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100k indicate severe labor market deterioration, signaling recession and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls by >100k, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 85.0% of 2017 base within 3 months indicates severe supply disruption, increasing inflation expectations and reducing corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 85.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
